meta.title: Buka Workers
meta.description: Manage workers in the sidebar: every worker has an immutable identifier (id) used as the directory name and reference key, plus an optional display name; agents have a directory, AGENTS.md and project skills, while robots are fixed programs (v1 ships clock); an agent marked assistant can talk to people for human tasks, and each agent can pick the model for its new sessions. The registry is version 4 (id / name / driver / assistant), data from older registries is migrated automatically (the old name becomes the id), renaming only changes the display name, and session compaction and result retries are removed.
